sources.title: RedHatAI/Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct-FP8 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Model Optimizations This model was obtained by quantizing the weights of Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct to FP8 data type. This optimization reduces the number of bits used to represent weights and activations from 16 to 8, reducing GPU memory requirements (by approximately 50%) and increasing matrix-multiply compute throughput (by approximately 2x).

sources.snippet: What is Llama-3.2-3B-bnb-4bit? Llama-3.2-3B-bnb-4bit is a quantized version of Meta's Llama 3.2 language model, optimized using bitsandbytes for efficient deployment. This model represents a significant advancement in making large language models more accessible and resource-efficient while maintaining strong performance.
